items.title: Inventory legacy Koala dev-memory entries and define supersession mapping
items.context: Scan project/global dev-memory for Koala/.koala/koala-* terms. Preserve old entries as historical evidence, but define a machine-readable supersession mapping to Proofbound/Lattice terminology.

items.title: Implement dev-memory supersession priority for preflight/search/list consumers
items.context: Entries tagged supersedes-<id> or referencing dev-memory:<id> should cause the superseding entry to rank ahead of legacy entries; legacy entries should remain readable but show superseded metadata so hosts do not treat old Koala terms as active guidance.

items.title: Capture current Proofbound/Lattice superseding memories for legacy Koala lessons
items.context: Add project/global memory entries that map legacy Koala reviewer/delivery/CLI lessons to current Proofbound/Lattice naming. Do not mutate old evidence refs.

items.title: Add smoke coverage for superseded dev-memory ordering and legacy terminology mapping
items.context: A test should prove superseding entries rank before superseded legacy entries and that legacy Koala memories remain readable but are marked as superseded.
